label: Whatever is moved in a respect of physical MOTION_2 has a per se mover in that…, by Proof-by-cases
meaning: Case analysis on Physics VIII.4's division of physical motion: a forced motion has another as mover; a natural self-motion has a mover; the natural motion of the light and the heavy has its generator as per se mover, or a per accidens remover and then, by the added premise, a per se mover too.
